args.body:
**Decision needed: error in the 2026-10-14 3% price increase.**
- The increase was applied to 22 FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT products (P-1201 to P-1222), which should have been excluded. This was my error.
- Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices. The total overcharge is 4,128.60.
- Recommended next steps: (1) I revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices. I'll do this on your OK, and I'll check the price history first. (2) Your team decides how to correct or credit the 8 orders. I won't contact customers.
- The data comes from a catalog check run today.
